It also calls scheduledExecutorService.schedule() which may throw RejectedExecutionException if the executor is shut down or its queue is full. Both are runtime exceptions. If these exceptions are not caught, they propagate out of the method without counting down the latch, potentially causing the waiting thread to hang indefinitely. Therefore, exception handling is necessary to ensure the latch is released on error.
